stories.title: Met launches murder inquiry after man shot dead at London memorial service

en.title: Met launches murder inquiry after man shot dead at London memorial service
en.summary: A 40-year-old man was fatally shot during a memorial service in East Acton, west London on Friday evening. Police have launched a murder investigation into what they describe as a senseless act of violence.

stories.title: Wakefield dominate Warrington in Grand Final to claim fairytale Super League title

en.title: Wakefield dominate Warrington in Grand Final to claim fairytale Super League title
en.summary: Wakefield Trinity won the Super League Grand Final against Warrington with a score of 23-10, securing their first championship since 1968. The victory marks a remarkable turnaround for the club, which had been relegated to the second tier before new ownership took over in 2023.

stories.title: Man shot dead as families gather for memorial in London

en.title: Man shot dead as families gather for memorial in London
en.summary: A 40-year-old man died from a gunshot wound at the scene of a memorial gathering in west London. The incident occurred while families were assembled for the memorial service.

stories.title: Christa Pike donated her last meal to homeless before botched execution

en.title: Christa Pike donated her last meal to homeless before botched execution
en.summary: Christa Pike's legal team raised concerns with a judge about using lethal injection as her execution method, citing her small veins and blood disorder as complications. Pike donated her final meal to homeless individuals before her execution.

stories.title: Kane and Saka double up as England school Croatia in historic Nations League rout

en.title: Kane and Saka double up as England school Croatia in historic Nations League rout
en.summary: England defeated Croatia decisively in a Nations League match, with Kane and Saka each scoring twice. The victory strengthens England's position in their group and improves their chances of reaching next year's quarter-finals.

stories.title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution

en.title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution
en.summary: Tennessee's prison chief is resigning following the unsuccessful execution of death row inmate Christa Pike. Pike survived two lethal injection attempts and remains in critical condition.

en.title: Tennessee's top prison official resigning after botched execution of Christa Pike
en.summary: Tennessee's corrections commissioner Frank Strada is stepping down following the failed execution of death row prisoner Christa Pike. An independent investigation into the execution failure has been launched by the state.

en.summary: Spain's housing crisis manifests through evictions and rising rents, which are symptoms of deeper underlying economic and policy issues rather than root causes themselves.

en.summary: A co-pilot attacked crew members with an axe in the cockpit of a Flydubai flight that was en route to Tel Aviv, described as a terrorist act.
